alexcrichton opened PR #14256 from alexcrichton:uniform-diasble-cache to bytecodealliance:main:

This was done in a bit of an ad-hoc manner where most tests passed -Ccache=n but not all. Now that environment variables can be used as well after #14217 it's possible to set this in one location and have it inherited everywhere else.
